ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) pixel distribution across the ventral surface with high-intensity (white) pixels limited to small, localized clusters and the distal tips; macro-ratio estimated at approximately 20:1 dark-to-light pixels.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Homogeneous dark field across both lobes. Discrete high-intensity pixel blobs are mapped to the extreme distal tips and as small circular and linear clusters on the inner left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a clearly defined vertex and an approximate internal convergence angle of 75 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations (jagged peaks and valleys) identified along the entire trailing edge boundary from the median notch to both distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve trajectory observed on both lobes, tapering from the wide central base toward sharp, elevated distal points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detected dense high-contrast white pixel clusters at the distal tips of both lobes; a singular circular ring-shaped cluster is visible on the mid-section of the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three distinct, vertically-aligned high-contrast white linear disruptions detected on the lower-central region of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive irregular white scarring and potential barnacle-related texture anomalies are concentrated at the outer lateral tips of both flukes.
other_distinctive_markers: A highly distinctive high-contrast circular 'O' shaped mark is present on the ventral surface of the left lobe.
